postverify: download every published wheel/sdist from PyPI
verify PEP 740 provenance / Trusted Publisher identity
clean install host plus first-party plugins from PyPI
run installed-image and out-of-tree plugin canaries
precheck: GitHub immutable release exact and replay PASS
all 11 project names ownership/pending publisher state confirmed
Trusted Publisher repository/workflow/environment identity matches every project
no target filename exists with a different digest
any already-present file must match exact SHA-256 and expected Trusted Publisher provenance
all internal dependency version constraints equal coordinated version
publisher_model: one GitHub Trusted Publisher workflow may be registered to multiple PyPI projects

transaction.basis: PyPI releases/files are uploaded one file at a time and QCAX spans multiple PyPI projects
transaction.dependency_visibility: a partial run may temporarily expose dependents before foundations; this is recorded as PARTIAL_PYPI_PUBLICATION and is not RELEASE_COMPLETE
transaction.on_mismatch: INCIDENT; never overwrite or blind-skip; evaluate yank of affected version(s)
transaction.on_partial_exact: PARTIAL_PYPI_PUBLICATION; re-read index/integrity state; construct a new missing-only exact subset after review
transaction.upload_order: NOT_A_CORRECTNESS_ASSUMPTION; the official publisher/tool/provider may choose file order
